Target unchanged; three Source statements are corrected and the landing path is wider than the card says:

- `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/components/ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` (586 lines, after #26696): Layout row `:390-396` (`LayoutSlot`, folds to icons), Group `:400`, Row Color `:426`, Hide Fields `:453`, Density `:484-506`, Row numbers `:510`, Edit inline `:519`, footer `:529`; props `ViewSettingsPopoverProps` `:64`; nothing about row opening. Its only host is `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5967` — not `ObjectView`: the new section's props travel ObjectView → plugin-view `PluginObjectView` → `ListView` → the popover.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/recordOpenPreference.ts` (#26804) is READ-only (`readRecordOpenPreference`, storage type `Pick<Storage, 'getItem'>`); the write function and a `setItem` storage type are this card's. `ObjectView.tsx:717-721` reads it once per mount (`useState(readRecordOpenPreference)`, no setter) and decides `opensBesideList` at `:740` — the choice must take effect live, so the read becomes reactive state the Display control updates.
- The name cell's anchor is `plugin-grid/src/objectGridLinkCell.tsx` `LinkCell` (`:83-175`, `host.recordHref` + `onActivate`), wired in `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` (`:397`, `:415`, `:635`, `:647`) — not `ObjectGrid.tsx`. No hover-only control exists in the cell; the hover-reveal pattern to copy is `plugin-grid/src/components/RowActionMenu.tsx:650`.
- i18n: flat `list.*` keys in `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` (`list:` `:990`) and `zh.ts` (`:756`) plus the eight other locales, and `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:1089-1090` keeps a defaults map byte-pinned to the en pack by `app-shell/src/__tests__/defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx`.
- Churn: `ObjectGrid.tsx` / `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` were split by `f79ec28949` on 2026-10-27; `ViewSettingsPopover.tsx` last changed by #26696 (`5cc31c7885`).
